snippet.title: Goat Simulator 3 – Ticket to Dizzyworld | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. Feel the g(oat)-force on the rides the park has to offer, turn visitors into baalloons, and trade Dizzy Tokens for rewards.

The park opens on November 19 on Epic, Steam, MS Store, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PS4, and PS5. With plans for Nintendo Switch 2. 
Secure your ticket today, enjoy the dizziness later. Wishlist now!

Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/goat-simulator-3--ticket-to-dizzyworld
